BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: Can you tell me common symptoms of methamphetamine use? ASSISTANT:

Common symptoms of methamphetamine use include increased respiration rate, loss of appetite, increased body temperature, decreased reaction time, increased heart rate, decreased ability to sleep, and distorted sense of sight and sound. Other symptoms may include mood swings, depression, anxiety, paranoia, and violent behavior.
